meta.title: SAP Vendor Master Creation: refused for a user without the MDM / Master Data Team role
gaps: Sign in as a user without the MDM / Master Data Team role on the specified Enterprise tenant
Verify whether SAP Vendor Master Creation is offered or refused for the non-MDM user
Sign in as an MDM / Master Data Team user and verify the SAP Vendor Master Creation succeeds with an SAP code
Repeat the same role comparison for Oracle Vendor Master Creation
Verify the tenant is on the Enterprise plan when no tenant or company ID is provided
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Sign in as a user without the MDM / Master Data Team role on the specified Enterprise tenant; Verify whether SAP Vendor Master Creation is offered or refused for the non-MDM user; Sign in as an MDM / Master Data Team user and verify the SAP Vendor Master Creation succeeds with an SAP code; Repeat the same role comparison for Oracle Vendor Master Creation; Verify the tenant is on the Enterprise plan when no tenant or company ID is provided

args.need: sign in as the non-MDM user and the MDM / Master Data Team user on the specified Enterprise tenant, try SAP and Oracle Vendor Master Creation, and record whether each role is refused, absent, or succeeds with the returned code

steps.note: The catalog cannot access the SAP or Oracle vendor-master workflows or hold the required role-specific accounts.
Check that the session remains free of a crash or server error after the tester's delegated verification.
